note: Ground truth for the eval harness. Never readable by packages/agents, packages/store or apps/server. Times are virtual microseconds from simulation start. Replay outcomes are what the simulator produced (seeds 42, 3, 7), not what the brief predicted; see NOTES.md, Phase 6.

rootCause.summary: The checkout v2.5.0 rollout raised per-request memory, so checkout pods exceed their memory limit, are OOMKilled and crash-loop.
rootCause.mechanism: A checkout pod uses 300 MiB plus 6 MiB per request it is processing, under a 512 MiB limit. v2.5.0 builds a per-request pricing cache (40 MiB per request), so a pod dies as soon as it processes six requests at once. Ordinary bursts get there: the pod is OOMKilled, its requests fail, it restarts after a back-off while the other pods take its traffic and die in turn (CrashLoopBackOff). With no ready pod, checkout refuses requests at once (503).

causalChain.step: checkout v2.5.0 rolled out: memory per request 6 MiB -> 40 MiB
first checkout pod OOMKilled about 1.6 s later (seed 42); the others follow; CrashLoopBackOff
